from scripts.document import Document, DocxXMLEditor

       'w:cs="Helvetica Light"/><w:sz w:val="24"/><w:sz-cs w:val="24"/></w:rPr>')

    para('RECOMMENDATIONS'),

    para('• Increase R&D investment in AI-driven product features to strengthen competitive positioning'),
    para('• Expand international market presence to support the 10-13% Q1 revenue growth target'),
    para('• Maintain disciplined cost management to sustain operating margins above 22%'),
    para('• Continue currency hedging programs to mitigate foreign exchange risk'),
